pattern: IM-L03 landlord's own contractor: after the chase the landlord says his handyman Dawson will do the window and asks the agency to cancel its provider
notes: Events 001-026 unchanged; shared block 027-030 as in v06. Event 031 (Tue 12 March 10:15): landlord: the Alder Lane plumber was for his other flat; his own handyman Dawson will do the window and call Eliza; cancel the agency contractor. Total 31, cut after 031. In the source the agency held "awaiting update from Dawson" for three months without contacting anyone. Expected: record the landlord's decision (own contractor); stand Oscar Turner down and unassign him, reminders stopped; tell the tenant Dawson will call and that Oscar will not attend; ask the landlord for Dawson's contact and an expected date; hold Waiting for Landlord with a short dated review. Passing the tenant's number to Dawson is fine via the landlord or with the tenant's agreement. No escalation, no agency provider.
